comment: This file is used to generate prey tags used in patrols.
The catalog is a dictionary of prey animals, keyed by the name used in prey tags.
The groups are used to define groups of prey animals, which can be used in patrols.
Add singular and plural forms of the prey, the biomes they can be found in, and the size of the prey.
New classes of prey (e.g., rodent) can be added to the catalog or added to groups (e.g., ground).
